description: This file provides declarations for functions returning string traits related to CUDA JIT compilation, used internally within the PyTorch library for generating code snippets or related string data.

methods.name: get_traits_string
methods.description: Returns a string containing traits information for CUDA JIT code generation.

methods.name: get_cmath_string
methods.description: Returns a string related to C math functions or code for CUDA JIT.

methods.name: get_complex_body_string
methods.description: Returns the string representing the complex number body code for CUDA JIT.

methods.name: get_complex_half_body_string
methods.description: Returns the string for half-precision complex number body code for CUDA JIT.

methods.name: get_complex_math_string
methods.description: Returns the string for complex math functions used in CUDA JIT.
